Description: A small shrine stands in a hollow, a stone idol with a smooth, faceless head. Every surface near it is covered with fungus except the idol itself, which remains scrupulously clean. The only sound is a slow dripping from somewhere deep in the rock.

Replies.ReplyText: Offer your blood to the shrine.
Replies.SsText: The idol drinks the blood and a warm light travels across your gear. When it fades, one of your cards feels sharper.
The idol cracks open and spills out a hoard of old offerings.
Replies.FlText: The shrine's keepers rise from the fungus and descend on you.

Replies.SsText: You step softly past the idol and leave it undisturbed. The silence follows you for a while.
